Question: assalamualaikum. Ramzan ki paanch shabe qadra me kaun si shab sabse afzal hai.aur kyun? 2}shabe qadra ki raaton me kis tarah se ebadat karni chahiye pls give the answr soon.as soon as it is possible. Answer ID: 7025 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1789/1389=H/1429) (1) Based on some Aahadith and traditions, the majority of Ulama are of the opinion that 27 night of Ramazan is most probably the night of Qadr. So, this night may be better than other nights. (2) Besides Fardh , Sunnah and Tarawih , one, to his best, should keep on offering nawafil , reciting the Holy Quran and durood , doing repentance and seeking forgiveness as well as reciting other doxologies ( tasbihat ). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
